children: Welcome to our weekly ChartWatch *LIVE* Webinar series. Hundreds of Aussie investors joined me at lunchtime to learn more about technical analysis by using the ASX stocks they’re interested in as case studies.
But that’s the point of ChartWatch *LIVE*: it’s not up to me to set the agenda – it’s up to you! 🫵
Click the "Watch on YouTube" button in the player above, or go to our YouTube page, to check out our other fantastic technical analysis videos when you're done with this one!

If you attended, I trust that you enjoyed the session and leant plenty about how to think and act like a trend following technical analyst. If you weren't able to make it, or if you haven't registered yet, then I hope you can join me Wednesday, 9 September, at 12:00pm AEDTfor the next instalment. Be sure to bring an open mind about investing plus two of your favourite ASX stocks for me to analyse!
In this week's edition (click links to jump to a segment of the video 📺!)
00:13:30 AROUND THE GROUNDS Brent Crude Oil
00:14:10 US/AU Bond Yields & Equity Risk Premium
00:18:45 Europe, China & Asia Index Wrap (DAX, FTSE, Shanghai Composite, China Real Estate Index, KOSPI, Nikkei) & Regional Banks
00:21:55 Soft Commodities, Coal, Uranium, US Dollar, Copper & Gold
00:31:45 Vault Minerals (VAU), Ora Banda Mining (OBM) & Catalyst Metals (CYL)
00:50:40 Trend Setup Matrix Explained (Continuation, Turnaround, Aggressive)
01:05:05 HOW TO GET CARL'S TREND RIBBONS

Learn more about technical analysis and trend following through real case studies on ASX stocks. Australia's premier technical analyst, Carl Capolingua, shares his unique insights on stocks as requested by viewers. Ask about a company in your portfolio or anything related to trading and investing and get Carl's expert opinion.
Oil prices are soaring again, compounding growing expectations for an imminent rate hike by the US Federal Reserve — resulting in surging bond yields and plunging stock prices.
In this edition of CharWatch LIVE, we breakdown complex financial market moves into actionable insights, delivered with the education dial turned up to the max!

Plus, you'll find in-depth sector reviews including ASX gold, iron ore and copper, the latest on CSL, agricultural stocks, and a deep-dive into September seasonality — explaining why now could be a good time to take some risk off the table!

title: Is this the end for the stock market? This expert analyst is loading up on cash
